name: Temperature x per-class isotonic blend
tagline: Per-class isotonic on temperature-scaled probs, blended with the temperature-scaled prediction by a CV-optimized weight under NLL+Brier+5·ECE.
init_recovers: Temperature scaling at α=0; per-class isotonic at α=1.
diff_from_baseline: Composes the temperature_scaling and isotonic_regression baselines: applies temperature first, then per-class isotonic on the temperature-scaled probabilities, with a CV-tuned convex blend weight selected against a tri-objective (NLL + Brier + 5·ECE).

name: Temperature + monotonic PCHIP spline
tagline: Temperature scaling, then a per-class monotonic PCHIP spline over 20 quantile bins, with cumulative-max enforcement and identity fallback.

key_hyperparams.name: n_bins
key_hyperparams.role: quantile bin count for spline knots

init_recovers: Temperature scaling alone if every spline degenerates to identity (e.g., very small calibration set).
diff_from_baseline: Two-stage: first the temperature-scaling baseline, then a per-class PCHIP monotonic spline (median-of-bin x, mean-label y) — closer to spline_calibration than to isotonic_regression because it uses fixed quantile bins and PCHIP smoothing rather than PAV.

name: Entropy-conditioned Dirichlet calibration
tagline: Multinomial logistic over [log p, H·log p, H, 1] with separate diag/off-diag L2 priors, label-smoothing, and a NLL+½·Brier objective.
formula: $$Z = X W^\top + (X H) U^\top + v\,H + b,\;\; \hat P = \mathrm{softmax}(Z),\;\; H = -\tfrac{1}{\log K}\sum_k P_k \log P_k,\;\; X = \log P$$

key_hyperparams.name: λ_W diag prior σ
key_hyperparams.role: L2 toward identity diag of W

key_hyperparams.name: λ_U diag prior σ
key_hyperparams.role: L2 on entropy-modulated diag of U

key_hyperparams.name: λ_U off-diag prior σ
key_hyperparams.role: L2 on entropy-modulated off-diag of U

init_recovers: Identity Dirichlet (W=I, U=0, v=0, b=0) → vanilla temperature-1 mapping at init.
diff_from_baseline: Departs from all three shipped baselines: a full Dirichlet-calibration matrix W on log-probs plus an entropy-modulated matrix U·(X·H), entropy bias v·H and constant b, with sample-size-scaled L2 priors that pull W diagonally toward I, plus a label-smoothed CE+0.5·Brier objective.

name: BIC-selected temperature/beta mixture
tagline: Confidence-gated mixture of temperature and per-class beta-style logistic; BIC then picks among id / temp / beta / mix per fit.

key_hyperparams.name: C (LR strength)
key_hyperparams.role: L2 strength on per-class beta logistic

key_hyperparams.name: small-N rule
key_hyperparams.value: binary, N<200: only id vs temp+1/N

diff_from_baseline: Builds on temperature + Platt baselines but adds a confidence-gated mixture between them and uses a BIC-style structural-risk score to pick the simplest model that beats identity, especially on small calibration sets.

name: Regularized beta calibration
tagline: Per-class beta calibration σ(a·logit(p) + b·log(1−p) + c) with L2 prior toward (1, 0), 5 init seeds, monotonicity penalty, and temperature fallback.
formula: $$\hat p_c = \sigma\!\big(a\,\mathrm{logit}(p_c) + b\,\log(1-p_c) + c\big),\quad \mathcal L(a,b,c) = \mathrm{BCE}(y, \hat p) + \lambda\,((a-1)^2 + b^2),\;\; \lambda = \max(0.5, 10/\max(N, 50))$$

key_hyperparams.name: λ (reg)
key_hyperparams.role: L2 prior toward (a=1, b=0) i.e. Platt

key_hyperparams.name: fallback
key_hyperparams.value: Temperature scaling if any test prob in [0.01, 0.99]^c violation

init_recovers: Platt scaling at (a, b) = (1, 0); temperature scaling at (a, b) = (1/T, 0).
diff_from_baseline: A regularized beta calibration with per-class application — strictly more general than the platt_scaling and temperature_scaling baselines (which it nests at b=0) — plus an L2 anchor toward Platt, monotonicity penalty, multi-init L-BFGS-B, and an automatic temperature fallback when fits look extreme.
